fusions.name: Draught Haul
fusions.desc: Drags a weighted link into the first enemy it meets that deals 8 damage, and you move 15% faster for 3 seconds. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Pulling Together
fusions.desc: Hauls a weighted chain into an enemy that deals 30 damage and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds. On a hit, every ally gains 20% damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Second Wind Tow
fusions.desc: Restores 3 stamina a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Tireless Gait
fusions.desc: Each time you spend stamina, you regain 2 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
